mode: shadow: executes the repository's feature builder and annotation chain; changes nothing
notes: fabrication_is_silent: on an all-absent frame engineer_features raised no warning and logged nothing at WARNING or above, and no record named a fabricated feature (measured; any would have refused the census); its only records are listed in builder_signals_under_absence
fill_precedes_scaling: the scaler is fitted on engineer_features output (census surface scaler_fit), so every fill above is a training value before standardisation

same_builder_at_inference: api/pipeline.py renders the contract with the same engineer_features; the two NaN-preserving features are then imputed with TRAINING-fold medians by the fitted missing-value policy

raw_inputs.measured_by: execution (a recording frame), equal to the builder's source text
